confirmed_task:
Use Slack's People or member-directory interface and workspace search to identify up to 12 accessible members associated with software development, support, product
    feedback, community organization, or documentation. For each person, report only Slack-visible information: displayed name, profile title or role, stated location or timezone if
    present, relevant expertise indicated by the profile or public messages, and one supporting public message reference when available. Group people by likely area of expertise, but
    mark uncertain classifications as unclear. Do not message anyone, open private conversations, or modify Slack content.
